Meet near the metro at 7:20 PM. Momos nearby from 9:30 PM.

Trade-off. Meera has the longest trip, so it starts at 7:30 rather than 7.

    Why not the others

    • Rooftop lounge

      ₹2,000+ each, over Meera’s ₹600

      Fits everyone if Meera stretches to ₹2,000.

    • Our usual café

      Not new for Rohan

      Fits everyone if Rohan’s fine with the usual.

    • Brunch spot

      Closes at 6 PM, before Kabir is free

      Can’t fit a Friday evening.

    • Street-food crawl

      Closes at 9 PM, too early for a 7:30 start

      Fits everyone if Kabir’s free by 5.

    • Kebab place with live music

      Few veg options for Aanya

      Fits everyone if Aanya’s fine without a veg menu.

    How this demo decides
    1. An option has to work for every ask: Aanya’s food, Rohan’s “somewhere new”, Meera’s budget and Kabir’s time. It starts half an hour after Kabir is free, because Meera has the longest trip, and it needs two hours before the place closes.
    2. If more than one works, it prefers somewhere new, then the cheaper one.
    3. If nothing works, it doesn’t guess. It shows what each option would need, so the group can decide.

    Four made-up friends, six made-up options and three fixed rules. Nothing here is a live recommendation, a real venue or a real price.
